raw_segments.text: They had waited for him and had already decided to bear the pretty flower-decked little coffin
It was the coffin of poor little Elisha.
He had died two days after Midia was sentenced.
At the gate of the house Alyosha was met by the shouts of the boys, Elisha's school
They had all been impatiently expecting him and were glad that he had come at last.
There were about twelve of them.
They all had their school bags or satchels on their shoulders.
Father will cry be with father, Elisha had told them as he lay dying and the boys remembered
Kalia Krasetkin was the foremost of them.
